title: l1qw.16.2: Rust gateway slot-claim COSE_Sign1 (resources.rs payload keys 1-7, alg -65537 check, gateway_count off-wire)
description: Child of l1qw.16 (GCP-6.5), lands with or after .16.1: rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs SlotClaim::decode/encode currently parses a raw map with gateway_count (resources.rs:310,378,412-436) and no COSE structure. Adopt the spec envelope: protected bstr {1:-65537} (REJECT others per validation step 4 — this is also the 'no alg check' divergence), unprotected kid, payload integer keys 1-7, signature over SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)) with lichen-link schnorr. gateway_count off-wire. Mirror the .16.1 vectors. Silent-discard semantics are .16.3's scope.
